I really like this idea but it sort of goes back to a post I saw where someone asked if you'd vote on things if that vote was made public. BUT then again it will at least have a public view on someone's metrics. Not sure if that'd fly or not with most people. Probably only the people that have something to hide anyway which is also another reason to implement it. BTW, that post you linked was hilarious :)

Having something to hide doesn't necessarily mean that you're a bad person. That's the whole, "If you have nothing to hide, you have nothing to worry about" argument. What if I have some sort of embarrassing health issue that I don't want people to know about?

Then again, most people will probably use a throwaway account for that stuff.

Caution on Votes: This should not be visible or even be made known that anyone can see your votes. There is a good reason that voting is anonymous. Just knowing that someone can see what you vote for will change the way you vote (when people start self-censoring.)

Anyway, it's not a bad idea. It'd be a cool feature to generally show where a user is active in terms of topics, which you can already tell anyway if you spend entire time scrolling through their history. On the other hand, I'd also like to have the option of hiding my comment and submission history from other people to make it more difficult (for your typical FB user with poor internet detective skillz) to sift through my history and piece together every little clue and hint and figure out who I am. This isn't incompatible with showing simple stats that don't reveal the messages though.

The keywords thing is creepy as hell though.
